scoring.lyrics_only_rule: Unsupported unknown answers are safe abstentions but recover zero musical information; Q5 and Q10 can score by correctly identifying uncertainty.
scoring.grader: Independent model-family review followed by aggregate verification

main_findings: Both music representations greatly outperform lyrics alone on recoverable music facts.
Compressed MSS leads natural language by only 0.2222 points on the 10-point objective scale.
MSS produces no zero-score objective answers, but more confident factual contradictions than the natural-language condition.
The most repeated MSS failures concern instrument abbreviations, inherited background references, and the 119.138-second handoff direction.
Both natural-language and MSS conditions preserve varied metaphors; this sample does not show a clear diversity advantage for MSS.
recommendation: Do not ship the current compressed MSS syntax unchanged. Keep numeric curves and layered event semantics, but replace ambiguous abbreviations and implicit handoffs with self-describing fields, then rerun the same fixed evaluation.
